title: SharePoint list filter stops working past 5000 items
description: The customer records list reached 8000 items and the filter now throws a 'View threshold exceeded' error.

worklogs.description: Defined an indexed column for the relevant column (Customer Code).
Recommended a Power Automate flow for lists with 5000+ items and shared a sample.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: The list threshold can't be raised in one go; recommended view-based filtering to the user.
